findings.rationale: Accepted: a hardlink shares the inode and is not a private copy. Materialisation is a plain per-file copy (reflink only where the copy call itself reports copy-on-write success), never a hardlink; before any seat launch the seat directory is re-hashed and must equal the shared packet_hash; the packet suite mutates a file in one seat dir and asserts the other seat dirs and the shared hash are unaffected.
